dining.name: Fun Town Market
dining.summary: The main market cafeteria — broad family options and the allergy handling that defines the Legoland standard.
description: Fun Town Market is the principal cafeteria: carved meats, pizzas, salads and a deep kids' range with real allergy competence. The indoor seating is the midday storm refuge as much as the heat one.
The noon wave peaks at 12:15 and turns over by one — the standard timing applies.
tips: Eat at 11:30 to beat the wave.
Allergy families: the counter's allergen guidance is the park's strength — use it.
dining.verdict: The reliable family cafeteria done at the chain's standard. Boring in the good way.

dining.name: Granny's Apple Fries
dining.summary: The signature snack's Florida outpost — crispy apple bites, cinnamon sugar, vanilla cream dip.
description: The apple fries cart carries the flagship snack to Florida: warm apple pieces in a crisp shell with cinnamon sugar and cream dip. The queue is shorter than California's and the product is identical.
It is the one food item at the park worth planning around, and the natural Dragon-queue reward.
tips: Eat them hot — the crisp fades in minutes.
One order, two kids, one negotiation. Or two orders.
dining.verdict: The park's best snack and a cross-country ritual. Worth the queue, worth the sticky fingers.
